result.summary: The screen appears well-formed overall: header, search, category chips, promo banner, restaurant carousels, and bottom navigation are all aligned and legible with no overlapping or missing elements. Only one low-confidence cosmetic observation was noted.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel appears noticeably washed out / lower contrast compared to the adjacent restaurant images, which makes it look like a partially loaded or faded image rather than a finished asset.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image asset and any opacity/overlay applied to it; ensure it renders at full opacity and with contrast consistent with the other carousel thumbnails.
